title: Erdős 249 visible-lattice model: convergence toolkit and rational Lambert falsifier

concepts.label: geometric pair summability
concepts.note: Absolute convergence of product-geometric and totient-weighted power families for parameters in the unit interval.

concepts.label: shifted geometric sum
concepts.note: The exact value of the positive-index geometric tail x/(1-x).

concepts.label: visible-lattice Lambert falsifier
concepts.note: The coprime-pair Lambert kernel collapses to an elementary square at every real parameter between zero and one.

concepts.label: geometric-model authority boundary
concepts.note: The zone validates convergent rearrangements and one rational-model no-go; it does not decide irrationality of the #249 constant.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED CONVERGENCE TOOLKIT: for 0≤r<1, the pair family r^(a+b) is summable over natural pairs and the totient-weighted family φ(n)r^n is summable; moreover the shifted geometric series ∑_{g≥0} x^(g+1) equals x/(1-x) under the same parameter bounds.
statement_nodes.engine: Factor the two-variable power into a product of geometric series, dominate φ(n) by n, and evaluate the shifted geometric sum by factoring one power of x.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Standard convergence and evaluation facts for geometric and arithmetically weighted power series.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: These statements justify later rearrangements only. Summability and a closed form for the geometric tail carry no irrationality information.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED MODEL FALSIFIER: for every real 0≤r<1, summing r^(a+b)/(1-r^(a+b)) over strictly positive coprime pairs (a,b) gives exactly (r/(1-r))^2.
statement_nodes.engine: Expand each Lambert denominator as a geometric series, exchange the absolutely convergent pair and scale sums, and apply the gcd-layer decomposition.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: A classical Lambert-series/coprime-lattice identity specialized as an explicit falsifier for the repository's geometric model.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The equality shows that coprime restriction plus geometric decay alone can still yield a rational value at rational r. It does not show that the #249 totient constant is rational, nor does it exclude arguments using non-geometric arithmetic structure, signed cancellation, or nontrivial cylinder interactions.

intra_zone_relations.basis: The convergence toolkit licenses the sum rearrangements and geometric expansions used to prove the exact visible-pair Lambert evaluation.
